title: Prosciutto Chicken Parm
summary: Crispy cutlets with a hidden layer of prosciutto, topped with sauce and melted mozzarella.
difficulty_reason: Three-step breading and shallow frying in batches, then broiling with cheese.

ingredients.line: 2 large chicken breasts, sliced into 4 to 6 cutlets
1 cup all-purpose flour, seasoned with salt, pepper and dried herbs
3 eggs, beaten with a little chopped parsley

steps: Slice the chicken breasts into cutlets and pound them with a mallet or tortilla press to an even thickness.
Lay a slice of prosciutto over each cutlet and press it in so it sticks.
Set up three dishes: seasoned flour, beaten egg with parsley, and breadcrumbs.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, dip in the egg, then press firmly into the breadcrumbs, keeping the prosciutto layer covered.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the cutlets in batches for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until deep golden.
Drain the cutlets on a wire rack and sprinkle with flaky salt while still hot.
Heat the broiler or oven to 425°F. Top each cutlet with a spoonful of marinara, a little parmesan and slices of mozzarella.
Bake or broil for 5 to 8 minutes, until the mozzarella is melted and spotty brown.
tips: Pound the chicken to an even thickness so it cooks through as the crust browns.
Salt the cutlets right out of the oil, while the surface is still hot.
